question: What does an exact manufacturing history add beyond nominal alloy and nominal recipe identity when interpreting present measured material state?

evidenceLayers.role: build, process, part, and thermography records with native identifiers
nominal material, machine, environment, laser, layer, hatch, and scan-file parameters
separately identified raw signal and derived TAM/SCR artifact references
2,248 coordinate-bearing XX and ZZ residual elastic strain measurements for B7-P3

identityRegimes.meaning: All three selected P3 parts share the recorded IN718 material class.
All three selected P3 parts share the projected nominal process recipe.
B6, B7, and B8 remain different build records even when nominal recipe fields match.
P3 from each build remains a different physical-part record.

identityRegimes.equivalenceKey: native measurement target plus technique, coordinates, components, and values
identityRegimes.meaning: Only B7-P3 has the selected residual-strain field; absent sibling measurements remain unknown.

historicalLoad.reason: The source declares neither a finite universe of possible manufacturing paths nor transition costs or a history-free counterfactual baseline; undefined must not be displayed as zero.

nonClaims: The three selected builds are not the complete AMB2022-01 process space.
A shared nominal IN718 material class does not establish specimen identity.
A shared projected nominal recipe does not establish build or part identity.
A prescribed process parameter is not an observed machine trajectory.
A thermography raw-signal record is not a residual-strain measurement.
TAM and solid-cooling-rate artifacts remain derived thermography products.
The B7-P3 residual-strain field is not copied to B6-P3 or B8-P3.
Spatially varying strain is not collapsed into a single complete material-state value.
Association between process record and measured part does not establish a unique causal mechanism.
The repeated B6 SCR filename in B7/B8 source metadata is not silently corrected.
Recorded XML dates are not promoted to a complete physical chronology.
Historical Load is undefined because no finite path universe and cost model are declared.
